purpose: Portable findings from existing current-core stack samples and audio producer traces; source-only follow-up review.

method.sampler: macOS sample, requested 1 ms interval, main-thread tree
method.selfSamples: Node count minus immediate child counts; distinct categories sum exactly to all main-thread samples.
method.inclusiveSamples: Contain descendants and overlap other inclusive categories; do not sum them.
method.wallToFrameBinding: Sample process start/end monotonic timestamps intersect producer native-call intervals in the same run.
method.host: Existing instrumented copies of current host classes, fresh saves, unchanged route/RTC/buffering/scheduling. No visible window.

windows.name: first gameplay
windows.selectedFunctionSelfScope: Null means the symbol was absent from the retained top-50 self list, not zero; zero GGPO inclusive count means it was absent from the full selected-inclusive scan.

windows.name: continuation
windows.selectedFunctionSelfScope: Null means the symbol was absent from the retained top-50 self list, not zero; zero GGPO inclusive count means it was absent from the full selected-inclusive scan.

conclusions: Both sampling windows contain the actual first-gameplay and continuation deficit frames identified by the unprofiled producer trace, rather than only relying on nominal launch time.

SH4 Run remainder and renderer descendants dominate both broad intervals. Renderer descendants account for about 23 percent of all main-thread samples; this is CPU stack residence, not GPU utilization.

Continuation has substantially more chain self samples. A low helper-to-chain sample ratio is not an admission or rejection rate: samples measure time, and the chain has six independently callable entries while only its first entry attempts contraction.

Generic function-table calls, other callers/targets, mid-chain scheduler resumption, comparison exits, and final iterations can execute the chain without a successful contraction. The present traces do not identify which dominates.

No direct GGPO active-query samples were observed. Its authenticated LIBRETRO constant-false stub might remove a call barrier locally, but its benefit is unmeasured; the mutable rollback query and other network guards must remain.

These data do not justify broader arithmetic contraction, changed scheduler budgets, hardware polling elision, fast-math, global aliasing changes, or a claim that one compiler/link tweak resolves audio recovery.

counterInvestigation.status: Source review only; no attempt/acceptance counters exist in this capture.
counterInvestigation.scope: Six-node fixed chain with one helper attempt point; ordinary dispatch and fallback remain required.
plausibleNormalRejections: Less than one complete continuing iteration of cycle budget remains.
Cycle pairing state is not the required steady state.
Function target or comparison value differs.
Counter is at its final iteration or outside the admitted positive range.
unmeasuredSafetyRejections: Reader/writer or live RAM mapping identity.
counterInvestigation.ranking: Unknown. Entry distribution and edge outcomes must be counted before treating safety-guard rejection as the explanation.

proposedDiagnosticOnly.gate: Fixed phase windows set at the original host frame boundary; do not query clocks or add bus reads per emulated instruction.
counts: External chain entry by node; internal node visits.
Edge exits by exhausted budget, different actual successor, or fetched-word/post-fetch-PC fallback.
Helper attempts, accepts, batched iterations, and iteration-count histogram.

First rejection class at existing short-circuit return points: context/budget/cycle state, observer state, reader identity, mapping/alignment, target/compare, count, code identity, overlap, final reader check.
constraints: Preserve evaluation and short-circuit order; reuse already-read values.
Bounded host-only counters; no guest writes, extra callbacks, per-event disk output, or altered fallback.
Record after shutdown; authenticate inverse instrumentation and unchanged other objects.
Require exact original-route RGBA/PCM/sample-count/SH4-tick equality before interpreting counts.
Treat instrumented timing as diagnostic only; do not promote or widen contraction from samples alone.

uncertainty: Both captures have trace overhead; the sampled run additionally has OS sampling overhead and is not a clean performance comparison.
Broad samples include onset, recovery and idle. Symbol offsets coalesced by the sampler cannot identify a single hot instruction within Run or the chain.
An inclusive helper sample count is neither a call count nor a fast-path success count; no admission percentage can be calculated.
Underrun counters describe producer/player queue policy, not independently measured device xruns or audible silence. No physical speaker or microphone measurement was made.
The strict playback checks still fail. Correct fixed-engine execution evidence does not establish smooth real-time playback.
